segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: Suno turns songs into videos
segments.point: Lyric videos, album art, AI clips
segments.narration: Suno now turns songs into lyric videos, album art and AI clips.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Suno launches Visuals
segments.narration: Suno launched Visuals on November seventeenth. Clips run up to fifteen seconds.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Drag a song into the Visuals tab
segments.narration: Drag a song into the Visuals tab. The model lip-syncs to your lyrics. Clips can be edited.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: Handy for promo, but credits are separate
segments.narration: Great for promo clips, but credits are separate from song credits, and shared clips are watermarked.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Test one clip on fast quality
segments.narration: Our take: test one short clip on fast quality first.
